description_expanded: OverviewPet Friendly - Steps to Pool,1 Minute Bike Ride to Public Beach, Restaurants & Shops, FREE Bikes! `Hartfelt`The Space QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Community Pool Access – Enjoy a refreshing swim in the neighborhood's community pool, just steps from your door. Proximity to Beach – A short 1-minute bike ride or a leisurely stroll takes you to the pristine beaches of 30A. 2 Bedrooms / 2.5 Bathrooms – Comfortably accommodates up to 7 guests. Master Suite – Features a king bed, en-suite bathroom, and private porch access. Bunk Room – Equipped with a full-over-full bunk bed and a twin trundle, complete with an en-suite bathroom and porch access. Open Living Area – Spacious second-floor living room with high ceilings, coastal décor, and abundant natural light. Fully Equipped Kitchen – Modern appliances and all essentials for home-cooked meals. Screened-In Porch – A cozy space to enjoy morning coffee or evening relaxation. Free Bikes Included – Explore the scenic 30A area with complimentary bicycles. Pet Friendly-Max 2 pets. $500 *refundable security deposit and non-refundable $150.00 pet fee. Welcome to HartfeltHartfelt is a charming vacation rental located in the serene Old Florida Cottages neighborhood of Blue Mountain Beach, Florida. This home offers a blend of comfort and convenience, making it an ideal choice for families and groups seeking a memorable beach getaway.Hartfelt provides a tranquil retreat while keeping you close to the vibrant life of 30A. The neighborhood boasts a community pool, picnic area, bathhouse, covered lanai, and grills, enhancing your vacation experience. The nearby beach access ensures that the sugar-white sands and emerald waters are always within easy reach.House Rules**No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:Master Bedroom (First Floor): King Bed, private en-suite bathroom, access to front porch.Guest Bedroom (First Floor): Full-over-Full Bunk Bed with Twin Trundle, en-suite bathroom, access to back porch.Parking for 2-3 cars. (Additional parking is the sole responsibility of the guest)-$150 non refundable Pet Fee and $500 Refundable (if no damage) Pet Deposit Required. Please contact our office after booking to add your pets to your reservation.-Guests will be required to be present at the property for any maintenance issues if you are unable to crate or contain your pet.-Walton County does not allow pets on the beach without a permit. In order to obtain a permit, you must be a Walton County resident.AREA ATTRACTIONS:Named after the area’s brilliant blue lupine flower, Blue Mountain is an unforgettable sight. Enjoy gorgeous views of turquoise water from the top of this beach neighborhood, which sits at a slight incline compared to the rest of South Walton. From cozy beach cottages to luxurious new homes, Blue Mountain offers a variety of accommodations for beach-goers to choose.Explore this beach neighborhood’s eclectic eateries and locally owned boutiques; or pick up a handmade creation at a Blue Mountain art studio. Experience more of what makes Blue Mountain unique as you jog along a running trail or enjoy a cup of homemade ice cream.Show less
